access: Optional: read access for the agent to the project's tracker and wiki (Jira, Confluence or similar) through an MCP server or connector; without it the guide is built from the repository and lists those sources with what to ask for

presentation.name: Prepare an onboarding guide from what the project actually contains
presentation.summary: Builds a newcomer's guide to one project: how it is built, the shared code to reuse, the commands that run it, where the tracker and documentation live, which skills fit which task, and a first-week checklist.
benefits: Traces one real path through the system with file references instead of touring every directory
Finds the helpers, macros and fixtures the rest of the code goes through, each with a call site to copy
Takes setup, run and test commands from CI and says which were run and which only read
Finds the tracker, wiki and dashboards from references in the repository and proposes read-only connections for the ones the agent cannot reach
Matches installed, catalog and personal skills to the project's recurring tasks
Ends with a checklist of actions that each have a visible result, and the open questions to take to the lead
